offers.t: LNDS-105 Senior Solution Architect I - Subsidy Projects (fixed-term 24 months)
offers.sn: Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg’s strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation.
offers.rq: BSc or MSc in a scientific, technological or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology or computing. 5 to 10 years working explicitly as a solution or enterprise architect on large-scale or federated data systems. Excellent communication skills in English. Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
